sentences.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
sentences.zh: 这个职位要求应聘者具备良好的英语口语能力。

sentences.en: The only thing that doesn't require skill is an appetite.
sentences.zh: 唯一不需要技巧的就是食欲。

sentences.en: He developed his English skill while he was in America.
sentences.zh: 他在美国期间提升了自己的英语技能。

collocations.zh: 社交能力 / 学习能力
